RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the March 7, 2008/Phalguna 17, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
182
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Decline in the wheat producing area
†777. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that wheat
producing area has decreased in the
country;
(b) if so, the main reasons therefor;
(c) the total estimated decrease in the
wheat production;
(d) the measures being taken by
Government to increase food production
keeping in view the increasing population
in the country; and
(e) by when these measures would be
implemented and time by when wheat
production would increase?
New farm policy
778. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) what are the concrete measures to
achieve new farm policy relating to
increasing farmers' net income, attraction
and retention of youth in farming and
processing of farm products, risk
management to sustain the farmers during
adverse circumstances, etc.;
(b) whether the problems faced by poor
and marginal farmers like continuing
farmers' suicide, especially in Vidarbha have
duly taken note of and farm policy has
been structured on the basis of a holistic
approach; and
(c) whether any monitoring mechanism
has been established for periodical study
of efficacy of new farm policy?
Dry farming techniques
779. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the steps being taken to develop dry
farming techniques in the country; and
(b) what new technologies are being
developed to enhance dry farming in India?

183
Agricultural growth rate
†780. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the rate of agricultural growth in the
last five years;
(b) the current agricultural growth rate;
(c) whether it is a fact that India is an
agri-based country;
(d) if so, the reasons for agricultural
growth rate not advancing; and
(e) the target fixed by Government to
increase agricultural growth rate in coming
years?
Recommendation of the CACP
781. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
SHRI B.S. GNANADESIKAN:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Commission on Agricultural Costs and
Prices has recommended MSP of Rs. 1,000
for rice for the forthcoming Kharif season;
(b) whether MSP for other agricultural
products have been recommended by
CACP;
(c) if so, the details of crops for which
MSP has been recommended and the
amount of MSP recommended, crop-wise;
(d) if so, what are the other
recommendations made by the CACP;
(e) whether the recommendations made
by the Commission and submitted to the
Government; and
(f) if so, when the recommendations
have been submitted and what action
Government has taken on them?
Inclusion of more districts of Orissa
under NFSM
782. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Orissa Government has
requested the Centre for inclusion of four
more districts under the National Food
Security Mission (NFSM) for rice and
three more districts for pulses, with a view
to secure food security;
(b) if so, the status of the proposal; and
(c) the time-frame within which the
proposal of the State Government would
be agreed to and sanction conveyed, if not
already done?
Failure of current pesticides
regulatory system
783. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the current
pesticides regulatory system in the country
had failed to check manufacturing,
distribution and use of spurious and sub-
standard pesticides which has caused huge
loss to farmers;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to revamp such regulatory system and to
prevent distribution of sub-standard
pesticides which is endangering the
environment;
(c) the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reason therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Price of milk
784. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the production of milk and milk
products, indicating demands and supply,
State-wise during last three years;
(b) whether price of milk has also been
increased in all States with the increase in
its production;
(c) if so, the average price of milk in the
country at present;
(d) whether the price of milk is beyond
the reach of most of the people, particularly
poor and below poverty line segments;
(e) if so, Government's response thereto
and whether Government has any proposal
for setting up innovative dairy projects;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
